from runtime import WorldSpec, Scene, Condition as C, Effect as E, Rule
from runtime import observe, tell, transfer
import random


def build(seed: int) -> WorldSpec:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    carrier = rng.choice(("log", "pads", "sail"))
    listener_place = rng.choice(("reedbank", "dock", "root"))
    style = rng.choice(("croak", "tap", "call"))
    water = rng.choice(("still", "rippling"))
    wrong_holder = rng.choice(("ada", "milo"))

    entities = {
        "ada": {"name": "Ada", "kind": "child"},
        "milo": {"name": "Milo", "kind": "child"},
        "pip": {"name": "Pip", "kind": "frog"},
        "tansy": {"name": "Tansy", "kind": "turtle"},
        "lilypond": {"name": "Lilypond", "kind": "place"},
        "reedbank": {"name": "reed bank", "kind": "place"},
        "dock": {"name": "old dock", "kind": "place"},
        "root": {"name": "long root", "kind": "place"},
        "stage": {"name": "lily-pad stage", "kind": "prop"},
        "pad1": {"name": "first floating pad", "kind": "prop"},
        "pad2": {"name": "second floating pad", "kind": "prop"},
        "log": {"name": "hollow log", "kind": "prop"},
        "chimes": {"name": "pebble chimes", "kind": "prop"},
        "sail": {"name": "leaf sail", "kind": "prop"},
        "rope": {"name": "rope", "kind": "prop"},
        "reeds": {"name": "soft reeds", "kind": "prop"},
    }

    initial = {
        "ada.location": "reedbank",
        "milo.location": "reedbank",
        "pip.location": "stage",
        "tansy.location": listener_place,
        "stage.location": "lilypond",
        "pad1.location": "lilypond",
        "pad2.location": "lilypond",
        "log.location": "lilypond",
        "chimes.location": "reedbank",
        "sail.location": "lilypond",
        "rope.location": "lilypond",
        "reeds.location": "reedbank",
        "log.owner": "pip",
        "rope.owner": "pip",
        "reeds.owner": "lilypond",
        "pads.linked": False,
        "log.anchored": False,
        "sail.display": False,
        "reeds.dampen": False,
        "water.condition": water,
        "carrier.kind": carrier,
        "style.kind": style,
        "tansy.hears": "vibration" if listener_place in ("dock", "root") else "quiet",
        "tansy.ready": False,
        "concert.arranged": False,
        "concert.performed": False,
        "concert.success": False,
        "tansy.response": False,
        "pip.memes.Ambition": 1,
        "ada.memes.Curiosity": 1,
        "ada.memes.Care": 1,
        "milo.memes.Curiosity": 1,
        "milo.memes.Care": 1,
        "pip.memes.Care": 1,
        "ada.knows.tansy.hears": None,
        "milo.knows.tansy.hears": None,
        "ada.knows.water.condition": None,
        "milo.knows.water.condition": None,
        "ada.knows.carrier.kind": None,
        "milo.knows.carrier.kind": None,
        "ada.knows.style.kind": None,
        "milo.knows.style.kind": None,
        "pip.knows.tansy.hears": None,
        "pip.knows.water.condition": None,
        "pip.knows.arrangement": None,
        "ada.knows.wrong_belief": wrong_holder,
        "milo.knows.wrong_belief": wrong_holder,
    }

    scenes = [
        Scene(
            "encourage_pip",
            "ambition",
            ("ada", "pip"),
            (
                C("pip.memes.Ambition", "ge", 1),
                C("ada.location", "eq", "reedbank"),
            ),
            (E("pip.memes.Ambition", 1, "inc"),),
            "Ada encouraged Pip to share his pond concert idea.",
        ),
        observe(
            "inspect_tansy",
            "ada",
            "tansy.hears",
            requires=(
                C("ada.location", "eq", listener_place),
                C("ada.memes.Curiosity", "ge", 1),
            ),
            summary="Ada inspected how Tansy listens",
        ),
        observe(
            "inspect_carrier",
            "milo",
            "carrier.kind",
            requires=(
                C("milo.location", "eq", "reedbank"),
                C("milo.memes.Curiosity", "ge", 1),
            ),
            summary="Milo inspected the available floating carrier",
        ),
        observe(
            "inspect_water",
            "ada",
            "water.condition",
            requires=(C("ada.location", "eq", "reedbank"),),
            summary="Ada checked the pond water",
        ),
        tell(
            "share_listener_clue",
            "ada",
            "pip",
            "tansy.hears",
            requires=(),
            summary="Ada told Pip what Tansy could hear",
        ),
        tell(
            "share_carrier_clue",
            "milo",
            "ada",
            "carrier.kind",
            requires=(),
            summary="Milo told Ada which carrier was available",
        ),
        transfer(
            "lend_rope",
            "pip",
            "milo",
            "rope",
            requires=(
                C("pip.memes.Care", "ge", 1),
                C("rope.owner", "eq", "pip"),
            ),
            summary="Pip lent Milo the rope",
        ),
        Scene(
            "move_stage",
            "cooperation",
            ("milo", "stage"),
            (
                C("milo.knows.carrier.kind", "eq", "pads"),
                C("milo.location", "eq", "reedbank"),
            ),
            (
                E("stage.location", "reedbank"),
                E("milo.location", "eq", "reedbank"),
            ),
            "Milo carried the floating stage toward the reed bank.",
        ),
        Scene(
            "link_pads",
            "cooperation",
            ("milo", "ada", "pad1", "pad2"),
            (
                C("milo.knows.carrier.kind", "eq", "pads"),
                C("rope.owner", "eq", "milo"),
                C("stage.location", "eq", "reedbank"),
                C("ada.knows.tansy.hears", "eq", "vibration"),
            ),
            (
                E("pads.linked", True),
                E("concert.arranged", True),
            ),
            "Milo and Ada linked the floating pads into a vibration bridge.",
        ),
        Scene(
            "anchor_log",
            "care",
            ("milo", "log", "tansy"),
            (
                C("milo.knows.carrier.kind", "eq", "log"),
                C("rope.owner", "eq", "milo"),
                C("tansy.location", "in", ("dock", "root")),
            ),
            (
                E("log.anchored", True),
                E("concert.arranged", True),
            ),
            "Milo anchored the hollow log beside Tansy's listening place.",
        ),
        Scene(
            "place_reeds",
            "care",
            ("ada", "reeds"),
            (
                C("ada.knows.tansy.hears", "eq", "quiet"),
                C("ada.knows.water.condition", "eq", "rippling"),
                C("reeds.owner", "eq", "lilypond"),
            ),
            (
                E("reeds.dampen", True),
                E("concert.arranged", True),
            ),
            "Ada placed soft reeds to dampen the noisy side of the pond.",
        ),
        Scene(
            "show_sail",
            "observation",
            ("milo", "sail"),
            (
                C("milo.knows.carrier.kind", "eq", "sail"),
                C("milo.location", "eq", "reedbank"),
            ),
            (
                E("sail.display", True),
                E("concert.arranged", True),
            ),
            "Milo raised the leaf sail as a visible concert signal.",
        ),
        Scene(
            "test_arrangement",
            "observation",
            ("tansy",),
            (
                C("concert.arranged", "eq", True),
                C("tansy.ready", "eq", False),
            ),
            (
                E("tansy.ready", True),
                E("tansy.response", True),
            ),
            "Tansy tested the arrangement and answered with a steady rhythm.",
        ),
        Scene(
            "quiet_tapping",
            "adaptation",
            ("pip", "tansy"),
            (
                C("tansy.ready", "eq", True),
                C("ada.knows.tansy.hears", "in", ("quiet", "vibration")),
                C("pip.memes.Ambition", "ge", 1),
            ),
            (
                E("style.kind", "tap"),
                E("pip.knows.arrangement", "gentle"),
            ),
            "Pip changed his music to a gentle tapping rhythm.",
        ),
        Scene(
            "perform_pads",
            "accomplishment",
            ("pip", "ada", "milo", "tansy"),
            (
                C("pads.linked", "eq", True),
                C("tansy.ready", "eq", True),
                C("tansy.response", "eq", True),
                C("style.kind", "eq", "tap"),
            ),
            (
                E("concert.performed", True),
                E("concert.success", True),
            ),
            "Pip performed a tapping concert across the linked pads.",
        ),
        Scene(
            "perform_log",
            "accomplishment",
            ("pip", "milo", "tansy"),
            (
                C("log.anchored", "eq", True),
                C("tansy.ready", "eq", True),
                C("tansy.response", "eq", True),
            ),
            (
                E("concert.performed", True),
                E("concert.success", True),
            ),
            "Pip performed a rhythm that traveled through the anchored log.",
        ),
        Scene(
            "perform_sail",
            "accomplishment",
            ("pip", "ada", "milo", "tansy"),
            (
                C("sail.display", "eq", True),
                C("tansy.ready", "eq", True),
                C("tansy.response", "eq", True),
                C("water.condition", "eq", "rippling"),
            ),
            (
                E("concert.performed", True),
                E("concert.success", True),
            ),
            "Pip performed a visual-and-rhythm concert beside the leaf sail.",
        ),
    ]

    rules = (
        Rule(
            "success_requires_test",
            (C("concert.success", "eq", False),),
            (C("tansy.ready", "eq", False),),
        ),
        Rule(
            "pads_need_rope",
            (C("pads.linked", "eq", False),),
            (C("rope.owner", "ne", "milo"),),
        ),
        Rule(
            "log_needs_rope",
            (C("log.anchored", "eq", False),),
            (C("rope.owner", "ne", "milo"),),
        ),
    )

    goal = (
        C("concert.performed", "eq", True),
        C("concert.success", "eq", True),
        C("tansy.response", "eq", True),
    )

    labels = {
        "pads.linked": "linked floating pads",
        "log.anchored": "anchored hollow log",
        "sail.display": "leaf sail displayed",
        "concert.success": "successful concert",
        "tansy.response": "Tansy's rhythmic response",
    }

    return WorldSpec(
        "The Pond Concert: Many Ways to Listen",
        entities,
        initial,
        tuple(scenes),
        goal,
        rules=rules,
        labels=labels,
    )
